performance.verdict: Meta dark for 4 days straight; all lead flow has stopped cold.

findings.text: Meta went dark Sep 14–17 (4 consecutive zero-spend days); $0 spent, 0 leads — all 77 28-day leads came from Meta alone.
5 SOW milestones overdue: renewal close (Jul 23), attribution gap (Aug 7), CRM cleanup (Aug 14), dashboard live (Aug 31), and August scoreboard trusted (Aug 31) — none marked complete.
3-day lead signal (Sep 15–17): 0 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 12–14) at 0 leads — drought extends back to Sep 12, 6 consecutive zero-lead days confirmed.
GHL shows 74 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments booked in 28 days — leads entering pipeline but no conversion to chair, intake leak not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped 69.86% week-on-week; ig_reach fell 66.44% — organic signal collapsing in parallel with paid outage, compounding visibility loss.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend immediately — diagnose payment, policy, or ad account hold causing 4-day blackout; no leads without it.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend for 4 consecutive days (Sep 14–17), erasing all lead flow — all 77 leads in the 28-day window came from Meta. Check for a billing hold, disapproved ad, or account flag and restore the campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' (28-day top spend: $346.93) to prior daily pacing (~$25–33/day). Success is confirmed when Meta spend resumes and lead count returns to 1+ per day within 3 days of restoration. Re-check by Sep 21.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib; dashboard and attribution gap are August scoreboard blockers.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue ranging from Jul 23 to Aug 31: renewal confirmation, phone-match attribution gap, CRM/contact cleanup, live dashboard, and August scoreboard sign-off. The client's stated walk condition is no visible return — without the dashboard and attribution fix, the scoreboard cannot be trusted. Nacer and Sohib must assign owners and due dates for each item by Sep 19. Success is each milestone marked complete or formally rescheduled with a new owner by Sep 25.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake leak: 74 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — confirm Lily's intake process and Flex Dental handoff are functioning.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 74 opportunities created in 28 days with $0 won and 0 appointments booked — leads are arriving but none are reaching the chair. This is an intake process or handoff issue, not an ads problem. Confirm with Lily that Flex Dental is receiving and acting on leads passed from GHL, and verify the biweekly Lily sync is identifying where drop-off occurs. Success is at least 1 appointment booked and logged in GHL within 7 days of process review, by Sep 25.
